messages:
Alex K: starting handoff — I’m Alex, primary for the next 4h. Quick summary: two ongoing alerts. INC-4593 embeddings-p99 (us-east) spiked after last config push. INC-4594 kv-cache evictions (eu-west shards 3-5) causing transient 5xxs for a small subset of tenants. No full outage but a couple of customers reported high latency.

sre-bot: Alert INC-4593 triggered at 2026-03-15T01:12:34Z — embeddings-p99 > 2.5s (source: metrics) Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/INC-4593

Maria P: I’m secondary for the next 2h. Been running mitigations on INC-4593 — temporarily increased batch_size from 4->8 on embeddings-worker pool and rolled back the prefetch flag. Observed ~30% improvement on p99 so far.

Jonah R: For INC-4594 I’m on cache sizing checks. Current eviction rate ~18k/min on eu-west shards 3-5. Starting pre-warm now (script takes ~6 mins).

Alex K: Mitigation notes for whoever picks this up: 
- INC-4593 runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-p99 
- Key quick commands: 
```bash
# scale embeddings workers
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=12 -n prod
# toggle prefetch flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" https://cfg.redwood/api/v1/flags/prefetch?value=false
```
- Note: regression correlated with model-variant switch around 00:58Z (v2-rc). If we need to revert to v2-stable, use the rollout play below.

Priya S: Customer-impact matrix — two paying customers (accts: acme-corp, brightlabs) saw >2x latency in last hour. CS has been looped. If latency >3s for either tenant, escalate to #oncall-sre and mark SLA risk. I already notified acct owners.

Lukas: APAC coverage note — I’m unavailable 03:00–06:00Z due to a maintenance window. That leaves a coverage gap for APAC primaries between 03:00–04:00Z. @Maria P can you cover that window? If not, ping @Jonah R to confirm.

Maria P: I can cover APAC 03:00–04:00Z. I’ll set a temporary reroute policy to prefer eu-west for APAC traffic during the gap: 
```json
{
  "route": "prefer-eu-west",
  "duration": "1h",
  "reason": "APAC coverage gap"
}
```
(Will apply via Console -> Routing -> Temporary Policies)

Alex K: Additional mitigation in progress: enabled temporary rate-limit backpressure on noisy tenant acme-corp to reduce eviction churn.
- CLI:
```bash
redwoodctl tenants rate-limit set --tenant acme-corp --qps 6
```
Monitor logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/queries?q=eviction+acme-corp

Priya S: Eviction runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction 
If you need to increase cache size (ops DB):
```sql
UPDATE shard_config SET cache_mb = cache_mb + 1024 WHERE shard_id IN (3,4,5);
```
(ops DB creds required — escalate to infra if you don’t have them)

Jonah R: Pre-warm script finished for shards 3-5. Evictions dropped from ~18k/min -> ~6k/min. Still seeing intermittent 500s attributed to cache miss storms. I’m watching response codes and will report back in 30m.

sre-bot: NOTE: Pager suppression active for INC-4593 between 02:00Z and 04:00Z — manual suppression by Alex K. Suppression ID: sup-abc123. Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/suppressions/sup-abc123

Alex K: Ops checklist before signoff: 
1) embeddings p99 < 1.6s (us-east) over a 10m window
2) evictions < 5k/min for eu-west shards 3-5
3) no customer with latency > 3s for 10m
4) CS updated (I emailed support@redwood.ai with notes)

Maria P: I’ll watch p99 for the next 40m. If it regresses I’ll do a canary revert to v2-stable: 
```bash
redwoodctl rollout model embeddings --from v2-rc --to v2-stable --strategy canary --canary-percent 10
```

Priya S: Escalation path reminder: ping #oncall-sre -> if no ack in 5m, page @oncall-manager (contact details in runbook). Also file a short incident note in PagerDuty after any customer SLA risk.

Alex K: Handing primary to Maria now — I’ll be offline for a short rest at 02:20Z. Maria, you’re primary. Notes saved: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/shift-6790012345 

Maria P: Taking primary. Acknowledge. :thumbsup:

Jonah R: Standing by for APAC handover if needed.

sre-bot: Thread flagged as handed off by Alex K at 02:22Z (handoff recorded).
